abstract: This research report deals with the simulation of a permanent magnet DC motor operating on continuous power generated from solar energy. The simulations results were generated using different controllers and H- Bridge Buck-Boost converter by varying the parameters of irradiance and temperature. The MOSFET of the H-Bridge converter deals with inductive back EMF. The inductive spikes drive back power into the battery, causing the current to fall rapidly since back EMF is proportional to supply voltage. Each subsystem was modeled in order to simulate the whole system. The main focus was to keep the system robust, minimize the loss and provide smooth operation of DC Motor. Overall, the system is simple, reliable and cost effective. It was observed that with a step change in input parameters, the PID controller enabled better performance compared to the PI controller.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of AMC based Metasurface Loaded Slot Antenna for Low Radar Cross Section
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, artificial magnetic conductor (AMC) is utilized to design a metasurface that is employed to reduce the RCS of the slot antenna. The proposed work is categorized into two parts. Firstly, two distinct AMC unit cells which have a phase difference of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$180\pm 37^{\circ}$</tex> are designed. These unit cells are then arranged in a checkerboard like configuration to design a metasurface. Secondly, a microstrip slot antenna with a single feedline is designed. The metasurface is then loaded on the slot antenna to reduce the RCS in a wide frequency range. The impedance bandwidth obtained for the proposed antenna is 9.67 GHz to 11.02 GHz with resonant frequency at 10.21 GHz. The proposed antenna achieved an average RCS reduction of 6.2 dB in the wide range of 5 GHz to 16 GHz and 10.35 dB in the range of 8 GHz to 12 GHz when compared with RCS of slot antenna. The in-band peak RCS reduction of 24 dB is obtained at 10.5 GHz whereas out-of-band peak RCS reduction of 22.7 dB is obtained at 11 GHz. For the proposed antenna with AMC metasurface, the Half Power beamwidth at 10 GHz and 10.2 GHz are 34.2° and 42° respectively and the peak gain for the two frequencies is 5.39 dBi and 4.07 dBi respectively.

articleTitle: A New State of Art Deep Learning Approach for Bangla Handwritten Digit Recognition using SVM Classifier
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has earned remarkable success in computer vision technology, particularly in image classification task. With the growing interest, it has been also employed to recognize Bangla handwritten digits. In this paper, we have presented a deep convolutional neural network with support vector machine (CNN-SVM) in order to recognize Bangla handwritten digits. Here, we have designed and implemented a 14 layered deep CNN architecture as a feature extractor to acquire remarkable features automatically from Bangla handwritten digits image and SVM was used as a classifier to recognize Bangla handwritten digits. We have trained and tested the proposed model with two different Bangla handwritten digit dataset namely NumtaDB and BanglaLekha-Isolated. The accuracy was found 99.53% on NumtaDB dataset and 99.59% on BanglaLekha-Isolated dataset. We also used our prepared dataset which is completely unseen to proposed CNN-SVM model in order to evaluate the generalization capability of the proposed model. The CNN-SVM model achieved a test accuracy of around 99% on our prepared dataset that indicates that the proposed model is reliable and convincing.

articleTitle: Detection of Glaucoma in Retinal Image using Image Processing and SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Glaucoma is an eye condition which can't be healed once it happens. In case the corrective therapy does not continue, its causes the permanent visual disability so it cannot be ignored. If we identify the disease at the early stage, treatment will be helpful. Many of the research work describe different techniques that are widely incorporated in detection of glaucoma disease. Through the best possible segmentation, we can identify optic cup and optic disc. In this paper, we proposed the technique based on OTSU's segmentation method to locate Optic cup and disc. Calculating only CDR (Cup-to-Disk ratio) does not help to distinguish all images as Glaucomatous or normal. Thus, we considered RDR (rim-to-disk ratio) to be another feature for glaucoma assessment. SVM (support vector machine) algorithm play an important role in evaluating disease progression. We also proposed a method where glaucomatic images are further classified into four different stages using ISNT (Inferior, Superior, Nasal, Temporal) ratio, CDR and RDR.

articleTitle: Smart Crawler for Harvesting Deep web with Multi-Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent era data available on the internet is playing a vital role. According to research, most precious and valuable data is present in the deep web so interest in techniques to efficiently site invisible web is increasing. The challenges to extract the deep web are requirement of huge volume of resources, dynamic nature of the deep web, coverage of a wider area of deep web and higher efficiency of collected results from deep web with accuracy. Along with all the above challenges, user demand of privacy and identity is to be maintained. In this paper we proposed a smart crawler that efficiently searches the deep web and avoids visiting irrelevant pages. A smart crawler starts crawling from the center page of seed URL and goes on crawling till the last link available. The crawler has an ability to separate active and inactive links based on requests to sever of hyperlink. The crawler also contains text-based site classifier using neural network and natural language processing as Term Frequency Inverse Document Frequency and Bag of Words with supervised machine learning techniques as logistic regression, support vector machine and naive bayes. Also HTML tags are extracted from hyperlinks along with data which plays a huge role in data analysis and all this is separately saved in a centralized database. Our experimental results with efficient link reaping rate and classification show higher accuracy compared to different crawlers.

articleTitle: Improving Skew Detection and Correction in Different Document Images Using a Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: During the optical scanning of a document using any of the Optical Character Recognition (OCR) devices, it is difficult to ensure that the scanned document will not get skewed. The high-speed scanning of the skewed document affects the text recognition process. Therefore, it is essential to de-skew the document images to improve the accuracy of the text recognition task. This paper presents a deep learning approach to detect the angle of the skewed scanned document written in different languages. Given the skewed images, we first predict the skewed angle of the document, and later we correct the document images by the angle predicted in reverse order. The angle prediction task is considered to be a classification problem with 360 classes. Each predicted entry in the vector represents the probability of the respective classes with each of value lying between 0 and 1.

articleTitle: Road Accident Prediction and Feature Analysis By Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the growing number of road accidents in the city Kerala, it is authoritative to carry out road accident mitigation processes to prevent damage of many lives. Handling of information mining has usually encountered issues like noise, high dimensionality and imbalance data. High dimensionality denotes to the large quantity of attribute among the data set. On the off chance that the quantity of attributes in a datasets is huge, at that point it is in all likelihood that a large portion of these qualities are repetitive or futile for building an prediction model and better result can be accomplished if the redundant attributes from the dataset are removed. Feature selection techniques are used to select the subset of the features which is used in the learning process. The SMOTE technique is used to handle the imbalance of the Kerala road data set then δ - agree based boosting algorithm for stacked autoencoder techniques are used for feature selection as well as data classification analysis. From this research, we conclude about various causes of the accidents, then find out total accidents per annual in separate state in particular time interval and helps to find accident trend in each state in each time interval over the year in each state.

Author Keywords: $\delta$ – agree based AdaBoost and Auto encoder

articleTitle: Non invasive assessment of Tissue oxygen using spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper is about designing and developing an optical system using near infrared spectroscopy to measure the oxygen level in tissues. This oxygen saturation is determined by the value `Tissue oxygenation index (TOI). This paper aims at finding the TOI values and states if it's in the normal or abnormal ranges. Abnormal ranges can denote problems such as ischemia. Conventionally, pulse oximeter is used to measure saturation in arterial blood. But it cannot detect the concentration of oxygen in tissues. Therefore a point of care system is developed to non-invasively monitor oxygen in tissues of forearm and palm by reflectance oximetry. Temporary occlusion is created by sphygmomanometer for testing and real time data are obtained by Arduino into MATLAB which is used for further signal processing.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning with Blockchain to Ensure Data Privacy
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Nowadays data is collected without any specific purpose, every activity of a machine or a human being is recorded, If needed in the future then the data will be analyzed. But here the question of trust arises as the data will go through many phases for the analysis by different parties. The data may contain some sensitive or private information that can be miss utilized by the organizations involved in the analysis stages. So it is needed for the hour to consider the data privacy issues very seriously. Data privacy refers to how to control the use of a piece of data by its relative importance. For example, someone will not hesitate to say his/her name to strangers but will not share mobile no. address until the stranger becomes familiar. In this digital age, the personal use of data privacy generally applied to critical personal information. From a business point of view, data privacy operates in a broader sense beyond the critical information of employees & customers. There is a general conclusion that AI & Machine Learning driven technologies are obstructed by data privacy issues as the ML uses large data sets to train & test. But can the obstacle block convert to a stepping stone? Yes, It can be. Imagine a scenario where no one is trust-able, so in that case, Blockchain enters the scene. Blockchain uses the data but in an anonymity way. So in this paper, we are proposing a way, how to combine Machine Learning & Blockchain to ensure data privacy.

articleTitle: Miniaturization of a Conventional WLAN 2.45GHz Patch Antenna using Slot Insertion Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper scrutinizes the miniaturization of a WLAN 2.45GHz microstrip antenna by adding slots on the radiating patch. Invariably the insertion of slots at edges increases the electrical length of the patch, which in turn shifts the resonating frequency towards the left side. After the shift, by miniaturizing the dimensions of patch antenna the resonating frequency is repeatedly centered at 2.45GHz. The conventional antenna is having dimensions 38mm×50mm×1.6mm. This antenna achieves reflection coefficient, gain, and radiation efficiency of -18.86dB, 2.33dBi, and 63.69%, respectively at 2.45 GHz. The antenna with three slots is having dimensions 8.75mm×31.5mm×1.6mn. This antenna achieves reflection coefficient, gain, and radiation efficiency of -23.11dB, -7.85dBi, and 10.65%, respectively at 2.45 GHz. This work concludes that whenever slots are inserted along the edges of the radiating patch then dimensions can be reduced at a cost of reduced gain and radiation efficiency. The innovated miniaturized antenna alliances with slots permit coordination with Wi-Fi application devices. The proposed antenna is fabricated, and the simulated results are verified. A good agreement is observed between simulation and measurement.

articleTitle: Low Power 32-bit Synchronous and Reconfigurable ALU Design using Chain Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Low power consumption is one of the leading design challenges while implementing any digital circuit. In platforms like wireless sensor networks where sensor nodes, located at various remote locations, are battery operated this challenge becomes more critical. Due to the lesser access to the deployment site, it is possible neither to change the battery nor to reconfigure the hardware to change the functionality of the deployed sensor node. Our approach of designing an ALU (Arithmetic and logic unit) with different arrangement and selection of elements than that conventionally used results in low power consumption (reduced by > 50%) without effecting the design complexity, total speed of operation and functionality. Additionally, the system is implemented on ZedBoard zynq evaluation and development kit so that the additional changes can be done on the hardware simply by modifying the HDL (Hardware description language) code.

articleTitle: A Novel Highly Sensitive Photonic Crystal Fiber Sensor for Detecting PH Levels of Acetic Acid Aqueous Solution Based on Surface Plasmon Resonance
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A novel PCF sensor based on surface plasmon resonance (SPR) to detect pH levels of Acetic acid aqueous solution is proposed in this paper. This proposed sensor has a sensing range for 1%-25% acetic acid aqueous solution (2.51-1.90 in pH level). Gold layer is used as plasmonic metal along with a TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layer for better plasmonic excitation and enhancing evanescent field. Analyte is passed through a rectangular channel in center and a channel surrounding the metal layer. For some analyte samples of refractive index(RI) ranging in between 1.33-1.37, we have investigated effective RI, relative sensitivity in x and y polarizations, confinement loss and effective area via Finite Element Method (FEM). As a result of proper optimization maximum wavelength sensitivity of 10,000 nm/RIU and wavelength resolution of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\times 10^{-5}$</tex> RIU is achieved at 1.3620 RI level which secures excessive detection reliability of minute RI changes. This sensor evinces moderated confinement loss which certifies simplicity in fabricating the design. Relation of confinement loss, relative sensitivity and effective area against wavelength show eminent indication of better sensing capability for various pH levels of acetic acid.

articleTitle: Ammonia Gas Sensor using $In_{(1-x)}Ga_{(x)} As$ as Nanowire Material
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we have designed and analyzed the performance of Gate-All-Around Cylindrical Nanowire FET (GAACNFET) with Indium-gallium-arsenide (In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(1-x)</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(x)</sub>As) as channel material and thin catalytic metal gate for the application of Ammonia (NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) gas sensing. Cobalt and Ruthenium are applied as a gate electrode due to their high sensitivity and reactivity towards Ammonia gas. In this device, when gas molecules are adsorbed over the thin catalytic metal gate then there is a visible variation in parameters like ON-State current sensitivity(I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub>), OFF-State current sensitivity (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</sub>), ON-State current to OFF-State current Ratio (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</sub>/I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</sub>) and threshold voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub>). Result shows that as the work function is varied from 0 meV to 50 meV, 100 meV, 150 meV and 200 meV for catalytic metal at the gate, then sensitivity also increases. Effects of different dielectric materials as gate oxide have also been studied.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence: Simulations in Audit Education
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The main purpose of the present study is to explore and examine the current status of Artificial Intelligence (AI) based simulations in management education in general and particular to audit education. There are few research studies available on AI based simulations in management education but very limited research has been done on `Audit education' by earlier researchers. The current research contributes to the scanty research by exploring the AI based audit simulations. This study explored and presented a total of 92 AI based Simulations, out of which 62 are developed by private firms and institutions and 30 are offered by universities in higher education across the world. Audit education has the least number of simulations and does not capture the whole need of the specialization. AI based simulations in audit education can potentially serve as a formidable tool to help students develop the situation-adequate moral sensitivity that our contemporary business world needs.

articleTitle: ExtraDet With Quad Feature Pyramid Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we look at different architectures of feature pyramid networks and introduce a new one, namely, QuadFPN. We apply this FPN technique to the popular EfficientDet and obtain an improvement in performance by a minimum of 1.2% mAP on COCO dataset on each of the models under 10 million parameters (D0, D1, D2). Thus, we present a scalable and an alternate technique similar to BiFPN.

articleTitle: A Novel Feeder Protection System Using Fast Switching PhotoMOS Relay
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The feeder system, being an intermediary element for the distribution of power to the regional transformer, the protection against the occurrence of any fault, becomes a requirement in the power systems. The power system protection devices are used to avoid such developing fault conditions. The relay circuits serve as the fundamental part of feeder protection systems wherein they are responsible for controlling the overload voltage and current to ensure the safety of the devices. In this paper, a novel model for feeder protection systems has been proposed incorporating the enhanced switching characteristics of PhotoMOS solid-state relay. The significant switching time for the open and closed-circuit operations have been obtained using the PhotoMOS device that resulted in switching time ratios (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</sub>/T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</sub>) 0.03 and 0.06, respectively. The result shows the considerable gain in the operational switching time parameter using the PhotoMOS device over the conventional Electromechanical (EM) relays. The obtained results also assure that the PhotoMOS is a useful relay circuit element and makes it suitable for future Internet of Things (IoT) applications.

articleTitle: Multi-attribute Decision Making Approach for Waste Bin Site Selection Problem: A case study in Dhaka City
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Site selection for the waste bin in a metropolitan city is one of the essential and critical decision problems taken by policymakers. An inappropriate site selection imposes excessive effects on the environment and health issues of city inhabitants. Nowadays, a multi-attribute decision-making approach is recommended to apply to progress exactness of decision making and lessen additional adverse. This work proposes a decision support framework for location selection of waste bin using the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) model. The major objective of this work is to determine the appropriate location for waste bin using this process in Dhaka city of Bangladesh. In this study, we have considered 7 attributes among 3 different locations of Dhaka city as alternatives. The alternatives relative importance has been calculated by using AHP. The ultimate decision is prepared based on the arithmetical scores snatched by the alternatives. A numerical study is presented to demonstrate the possible alternative of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: WiFi based Indoor Positioning System using Machine Learning and Multi-Node Triangulation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Global Positioning systems are limited by their precision considering the unreliable dependence on the number of satellites received at the instance. Indoor Positioning Systems require much more reliable systems which can be precise up to 2 ft hence ruling out the option of using GPS. The paper proposes a technique to utilize the existing infrastructure of Wi-Fi routers and mobile hotspots in the indoor environment to build a precise localization system. The paper integrates the correlation between RSSI values and transmitter-receiver distance with a model for coordinate system of indoor environment to find most probable coordinates of the receiver when multiple transmitters are present using novel multi-node triangulation algorithms. The IOT-enabled system is affordable, optimized and stand-alone, along with being non-line-of-sight, and offers higher precision than conventional GPS. Applications may be extended to localization system of UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) and UGVs (Unmanned Ground Vehicles).

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Vedic technology is the recollect given to the recorded indian contraption of calculating that got rediscovered in the mid twentieth century from vintage indian figures (vedas). It unequivocally gives with vedic numerical formulae and their hassle to specific bits of era. The calculations depending on famous calculating may be disentangled or even advanced via strategies for the usage of vedic sutras. These strategies and insights might be immediately done to trigonometry, plain and round geometry, conics, assessment (both differential and fundamental), and stated figuring of orchestrated kinds. In this paper new multiplier and square planning is proposed counting on set of policies of vintage indian vedic math, for low terrific and quick undertakings. It is predicated upon absolutely after passing on every single fragmentary detail and their wholes in a solitary flip of activities. The form execution on altera storm - ii fpga recommends that the proposed vedic multiplier and square are quicker than display multiplier and ward off multiplier.

articleTitle: CCSDS Based Spacecraft Telemetry System with Programmable Bit Rate and Turbo Encoding for India's Inter-planetary Exploration
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents various aspects of CCSDS based satellite telemetry system design and highlights the important development required to cater for Inter-planetary Missions. The various aspects include: Transfer Frame Layer implementation, CRC computation, channel encoding technique (1/2 rate Turbo Encoding for higher coding gain), Randomization, Bit rate programmability (lowering bit rate to augment signal Eb/No for higher orbits), formats (Normal, Dwell and PTM), Data Acquisition (FPGA based), Frame Size, Real-time/Near Real-time acquisition, Acquisition Interface Types (Digital RMU, Analog RMU, Digital bits, RF bits, Digital Word, Analog word, Thermistor), PTM formats (Launch, Early Orbit, Earth bound Maneuvers, Cruise, Interplanetary Orbit Insertion and Payload Operation phases), Command interface, Storage and Playback Interface and Sub-Carrier level modulation, Ground Checkout interface, AIT Interface, Transmitter Interface.

articleTitle: Impact of Emotional Stability on Work Performance of Employees Working in Steel Fabrication Companies
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The research suggests that the emotional stability of employees would allow better output for the organization. This study questioned and affirmed the nexus between the emotional stability and performance of employees. The research engaged collected primary data from 100 employees via a structured questionnaire. This study's findings showed that the quality of workers is a result of emotional stability. Provided suggestions could fix the gaps and obstacles.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Recognizing Bengali Character Sign Langauage
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: For many years, researchers are trying to recognize Bengali sign language for helping deaf-mute people which is very challenging task. Every research has its own margins and is still incapable to be used commercially. For that reason, device interpreter is obligate to accommodate that deaf and hard-of-hearing community to communicate with normal people. In this paper, the main aim to construct a model to recognize Bengali Character Sign Language using deep leaning approach. For that reason, we use Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to train individual signs. For those individual signs, a data set is constructed named Bengali Ishara-Lipi to achieve our goal. This model is trained by 5760 preprocessed images and tested by 1440 images. The quantitative relation of the trained and tested images was 80% and 20% severely. Finally, our model gained 92.7% accuracy to recognize Bangla alphabetical sign language. This model will avail for commencing to make Bengali sign language device interpreter.

articleTitle: T3D-Y Codec: A Video Compression Framework using Temporal 3-D CNN Encoder and Y-Style CNN Decoder
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has witnessed success and vast opportunities in the field of deep learning based video compression. Many deep learning models have either outperformed or performed on par with state-of-the-art compression standards like H.264 and HEVC. In this paper, we propose H.264 Inter-frame prediction based video compression approach using Temporal 3-D CNN based encoder and Y-style CNN based decoder. The proposed architecture includes three stages, Temporal 3-D CNN encoder for forward Predicted (P) frame computation, H.264 like Integer Discrete Cosine Transform and scalar quantization for entropy coding and Y-style CNN for P-frame decoding. The experiments are conducted with different training loss functions and different datasets. The results show that the proposed model outperforms the state-of-the-art compression standards with low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Classification of Brain MRI Images Using Convolution Neural Network and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) is a non intrusive procedure for obtaining high resolution images of living tissues. Varieties of tissue contrast images that MRI modalities produce provide important structural information, enabling diagnosis and segmentation of tumors. In this paper we come up with an integrated model of Convolutional Neural Network and Transfer learning for automated binary classification of brain MRI images. We use a sixteen layer pretrained network, to distinguish normal and abnormal images. Our experiments suggest good accuracy in classification on test data, and thus will turn out to be useful for efficient automated diagnosis.

articleTitle: Noise Power Estimation for OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper addresses the calculation of noise power for the OFDM system using repeated nulled subcarriers. Most of the methods, which are already in use are calculated the noise power in the frequency domain by assuming perfect Carrier Frequency Offset(CFO). Hence, it leads to degradation of performance. In this paper, we proposed a time-domain periodic nulled subcarrier based method for estimating the noise power by assuming the existence of CFO. The noise power can be determined by calculating the second-order moment for the received periodic nulled subcarriers. The periodic repetition of nulled subcarriers is used for developing a computationally efficient algorithm. Compared to the existing noise power estimators, the proposed estimator reduces computational complexity significantly and also, this method doesn't require pilot carriers like other time-domain noise estimation methods. Hence, significant power saving can also be achieved through proposed noise power estimator.

articleTitle: Best Fit Polygonal Approximation for Multiple ROI Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Best Fit Ploygonal Approximation for Multiple ROI Estimation is a difficult activity and most computerized imaging applications require it as a preprocessing step. Among different calculations, albeit part and consolidation (SM) calculation is profoundly utilized on account of its straightforwardness and adequacy in fragmenting homogeneous districts, be that as it may, it can't portion a wide range of items in all pictures. The motivation of the research work is to find multiple region of interest in single image. It is useful for radiologists to identify an ROI position relative to another ROI. It is beneficial if multiple measurements of various tissue structures are to be made in single slice. This paper addresses multiple ROI of different shapes and structures. To detect homogeneous parts it is important to extract only those affected regions which are possible with the help of ROI (region of interest). ROI is a part of an image which you want to separate from the original image. It is generally used to mask voxels. In this research paper we mainly focus on multiple ROI where the original image will be split into different regions with the help of split algorithm and apply any of the ROI extraction technique to extract the effected piece and merge them using merge algorithm and finally image reconstruction is done to get the required image.

articleTitle: Improved Feature Generalization in Smaller Datasets with Early Feature Fusion of Handcrafted and Automated Features for Content Based Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diverse techniques of feature extraction are carefully crafted by researchers in the domain of content based image classification for improved categorization of image data. These are handcrafted techniques of descriptor definition which have mostly emphasized in representing a particular feature of the query image. Recent advancements in deep neural networks have enabled extraction of features in automated manner without any human intervention. The process considers multiple dimensions of image properties in designing content based descriptors. However, deep features have shown limitations for generalization of feature vectors when number of training instances are small. The pre-trained CNN networks have also revealed limitations in generalization of extracted features from smaller datasets. This work has attempted to address this issue by designing fusion based architecture. In the process, the authors have experimented with features extracted with individual techniques comprising of handcrafted extraction and automated neural network based extraction from a small dataset. The process of feature extraction is carried out on an imbalanced dataset for which the classification evaluation is done with F1 Score. The experimental process has revealed better feature generalization with enhanced classification performances by application of early fusion of extracted features compared to that of features extracted with single techniques.

articleTitle: An Approach for Bengali Automatic Question Answering System using Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Question answering is a set of tools for obtaining detailed answers from user questions. At present, it is gaining very popularity day by day in the area of NLP research. There is a lot of work done in English. Still, become the seventh spoken language has not notable development at all. In Bengali very little work we've seen so far. Many types of problems can be solved by answering questions. Automatic question answering system is very much needed to solve various problems through Q&A. It is a very challenging task to create this type of system. In our paper we developed an automatic context based Question&Answering system using sequence to sequence architecture. An encoder layer will be used with a bi-directional LSTM and a decoder layer followed by an attention mechanism. The main challenge of this work is - data collection, finding the right vocabulary for word mapping and lots more. The main function of our model is to answer the questions. We have been able to successfully answer the question and reduce our training loss to 0.003.

articleTitle: Image encryption using a new 2D bit reversed logistic map
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A new 2D chaotic map is proposed using a recently proposed bit reversal operation to enhance the classic 1D logistic map. The map's is subjected to some standard tests so as to validate it's pseudo-random number generation capabilities. The bit reversed 2D logistic map is used to generate a sequence of a pair of random numbers with a continuous variation of the enhanced logistic map's parameter. The 2D map s then used to implement an image encryption schema. A sequence of simulation runs are carried out to verify the over all effectiveness of the method in terms of parameters like sensitivity to initial key and sensitivity to input plain image. Comparisons with previously reported related algorithms are also shown.

articleTitle: Tracking Targets using Digital Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Anti aircraft systems have the objective of reducing or mitigating actions involving the detection and disabling of enemy aircraft reaching a significant area. These devices ought to be prepared to protect sensitive assets from high-altitude, high-speed enemy fighters assaults by working out accurate jet bombardments. Hence the computer system should be able to foresee the location glide path in order to defeat the targets before the precise missile strike. Amplitude monopulse radar system that is capable of calculating the projected target trajectory based on the MATLAB amplitude monopulse radar system. The 4 beams are generated with a single antenna feed which uses a pulse, Hence the name "Monopulse". By developing 4 horn monopulse the elevation differences Δel, azimuth difference Δaz and sum Σ of these beams are produced. Updating antenna design with single feature and squinted angle Σ(φ) sum signal and difference signal Δ(φ) is calculated. By defining the signals S1 and S2 the error signal output is generated . The target's azimuth and elevation angle are determined, too. The intrinsic Kalman filter is capable of tracking maneuvering goals and SNR of the target is also calculated. The 4 feed horn beams are plotted in 75deg and 45deg where the ground level objectives and objectives such as aircraft are identified. From antenna viewpoint, the aim trajectories were found to be recorded in both the global coordinate system and the local coordinate system. Transmitted and received pulse are also detected. Kalman filter is used to get the location of truth and the expected location of the target is estimated and the goal's SNR is also calculated.

articleTitle: Optick - A Low Cost Wearable Head up Display for Search and Rescue Operations
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Optick is a visual aid for search and rescue operators during disaster management to help save lives while protecting their own by detecting the presence of humans in low visibility environments and monitoring the toxicity of gases inhaled. There are three main aspects of this device. The first is interfacing the MQ-7 (Carbon Monoxide sensor) and the CCS811 (Carbon Dioxide and Volatile Organic Compounds sensor) with the Raspberry Pi Zero and the OLED display. The second is the detection of humans using the AMG8833 thermal sensor to capture temperature readings which are sent to a trained Deep Learning model. Finally, Optick focuses the display into the eye of the rescuer, giving them the ability to view overlaid information with no hindrance to normal vision. A 3D-printed enclosure is designed for effective use on the operator's head. Additionally, a capacitive sensor is made to detect the presence of the rescuer's hand to switch between the device's modes of operation.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement for OADM based DP-QPSK WDM Optical Networks with 37.5 GHz Channel Spacing
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dual polarization quadrature phase shift keying (DP-QPSK) wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) system with 50 GHz channel spacing is currently providing various high-speed data services. The spectral efficiency (SE) of DP-QPSK WDM systems can further be increased by decreasing the channel spacing to 37.5 GHz. The 37.5 GHz frequency grid promises 33% increase in the throughput. However OADMs located at intermediate nodes in an optical network limit the performance of the 37.5 GHz, DP-QPSK WDM system. The narrowband optical filtering and crosstalk introduced by cascading OADMs limits its performance. In this paper, we presents that if the filter order of WDM multiplexer and demultiplexer is kept different it leads to an improvement in the performance of 37.5 GHz, DP-QPSK WDM optical networks. Further a significant improvement can be achieved by assigning unequal launch power on adjacent channels.

articleTitle: Lane Departure Warning System using TDA3x_rvp Board
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The man's desire to own luxury cars has always shown an increasing growth. From past 10 years, the number of vehicles that are sold in India have skyrocketed. This trend has a direct impact on the number of accidents that are occurring on Indian roads. Nearly, 1.35 million road traffic fatalities occur annually. In majority of the cases, accident occurs when one car comes into the path of the other which is caused due to the risk of driver losing his control over the car. This raises the need for advanced technologies to alert drivers of potential hazards and allow drivers to take good time taking control of the vehicle. One of the Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), lane departure warning system (LDWS) helps drivers to avoid these tragedies. In this paper, the above mentioned system is developed using TDA3x_RVP board as this is a highly optimized and robust set of tools designed to meet automotive industry requirements. It is also conveniently flexible in the existing framework and can be expanded to incorporate other applications. The proposed approach detects the lanes by determining the number of left lane points and the right lane points based on certain rho and theta threshold parameters, and warns the driver in case of unintentional lane shifts that can be either left lane or right lane.

articleTitle: Image Encryption Using Genetic Algorithm and Bit-Slice Rotation
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cryptography is a powerful means of delivering information in a secure manner. Over the years, many image encryption algorithms have been proposed based on the chaotic system to protect the digital image against cryptography attacks. In chaotic encryption, it jumbles the image to vary the framework of the image. This makes it difficult for the attacker to retrieve the original image. This paper introduces an efficient image encryption algorithm incorporating the genetic algorithm, bit plane slicing and bit plane rotation of the digital image. The digital image is sliced into eight planes and each plane is well rotated to give a fully encrypted image after the application of the Genetic Algorithm on each pixel of the image. This makes it less prone to attacks. For decryption, we perform the operations in the reverse order. The performance of this algorithm is measured using various similarity measures like Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM). The results exhibit that the proposed scheme provides a stronger level of encryption and an enhanced security level.

articleTitle: Analysis of Microstructured Photonic Crystal Fiber: An Improved Design
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A single-mode defected core hexagonal photonic crystal fiber (H-PCF) is presented for the wide-band dispersion compensation at the wavelength interval 1350 to 1600 nm over the telecommunication windows. Finite element method (FEM) is incorporate to investigate the characteristics of the proposed PCF. Throughout the simulation, we found dispersion of −2160 ps.nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and high nonlinearity of 120 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> at the operating wavelength of 1550 nm. Our proposed paper enhances its attraction for using single circular hole of air in the core site which is the most suitable one for the optical fiber communication systems.

articleTitle: Unit Testing for USB Module Using Google Test Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Program testing and analysis play a vital role in forthcoming applications due to the integrity of layers of code by third party members, if one module or component fails, it impacts the entire application at the end-to-end testing. This paper addresses the essence of Unit testing for an organization or for an application, which helps to debug issues at an early stage in the developing phase to improves code quality and supports to make a system work accordingly as expected. The main goal of the project is to do Unit Testing on the USB Module for washing machine Using Google Testing Framework. In the project, a set of test scripts are developed by using Google-Test which is a testing framework for testing the functionality of the USB Module. The project makes use of a wide range of fatal and non-fatal assertions to test the module developed for the purpose of to and fro data transfer in washing machines.

Author Keywords: exporting and importing modes of data

articleTitle: A framework to establish a Rule-based specialized dropout prevention scheme
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Many students drop out of Bangladesh universities. Particularly for tech or related undergraduate program where a strenuous effort and technical ability is needed to obtain a successful academic outcome, every student who drops out of university has a specific circumstance. This dissertation aims at discovering the structure of factors behind and solution for dropout. Various machine learning algorithms have been used in classifying the issues behind dropout.

articleTitle: Design & Implementation Of IoT Based Industrial Automation Syste
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Internet of things is the most updating technology in recent years. Now anyone can easily monitor, measure, control, find updated information and data like how much product produce in per hour, per day, per week of any industry through IOT. And also can observe continuous update of running condition in sited anywhere. The paper proposes piece together with monitoring, controlling, measuring, product counting and finding updated information of any automatic industry using IoT. This embedded system designed by Raspberry pi, cloud server to be more exact. Here Raspberry pi operates the whole system, analyzes performance and machine observation, makes it unique than other systems. It provides not only controls but also self-analyzed data result by which productivity and efficiency can be increased. Here the cloud server works as a connector between industry and control device where all information are stored through Raspberry pi. The cloud server is created by CAYENCE software. To implement the whole system successfully, it uses Linux operating system and Python. HTML programming language is used in the system for coding purpose.

articleTitle: Development of Quad Spacer Damper to suppress oscillation in 765 kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Now-a-days, transmission of bulk electricity over long distance is essential for power evacuation from far distant fossils plant as well as effective green energy harvested from remotely available renewable sources. Reliable and uninterrupted delivery of electricity to the consumers is prime importance for every utility. These transmission lines are exposed to several environmental factors which results into conductors' vibration, which may lead to fatigue of conductor strands and premature failure. The proposed quad spacer damper is found to be effective in maintaining reliability of these lines. In this analysis, a quad spacer damper is proposed as a damping solution of 765 kV overhead transmission lines under influence of variable wind and ice loading conditions. Here, the quad spacer damper is being designed using CATIA V5R20 software tools along with sustainability check by virtual simulation. The spacer was tested for the quad bundle ACSR Bersimis conductor. The field test was conducted on 29 spacer dampers installed on a conductor across the line. This in-house designed and developed quad spacer damper is qualified for the full range of laboratory tests to ensure consistency of operation under vibration, differential ice loadings, forces due to electrical line faults etc.

articleTitle: Context-Aware Computing for Balanced Agricultural Production using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Agriculture is the foundation factor of many developing countries' economy. Now we are in the era of industrial revolution and especially the developing countries are shifted their vision completely to this revolution. But, they are not thinking about smart cultivation and more production from this ancient key factor of economic growth. Still farmers are following the ancient techniques for cultivation without thinking different dimensions or key factors for better production. Farmers should understand the present context for cultivating any crops to get proper profit against any specific cultivation. And to do this study they have to analysis statistical data of production report over a long period considering climate, region, availability of pesticides, period specific demand and so many dimensions. So we have to employ the context-aware computing to estimate the reasonable balanced production of any crops. In many countries like; Bangladesh in every cultivation season many farmers are not getting proper price of their crops due to over production. Sometimes farmers fail to return their invested money for their cultivation where their time and physical effort is completely a loss. To address this vital issue our research work will do proper context-aware analysis. This paper's agricultural context-aware computing for balanced production deals with extract-transform-loading (ETL), data warehousing (DWH), dimension (period, weather, pesticides etc.) specific data visualization, and supervised learning process to estimate future production.

articleTitle: Analysis of ECG for biometric identification
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the advent of smart applications and smart technologies, security and authentication has become a vital necessity. This need of the hour has given an impetus to the research in biometric systems. This paper explores the performance of ECG based biometric systems and presents an identification algorithm using a single heart beat. The baseline wander and power line interference are first removed from the acquired ECG signal using Fourier decomposition method to ensure the correct peak detection. The algorithm proposed here uses both fiducial as well as non-fiducial features. The fiducial features includes characteristics of PQRST waves like their amplitude, time duration, slope, etc., obtained using Pan Tompkins algorithm whereas autoregressive (AR) model parameters and L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> norm are the non-fiducial features computed for each beat. We then select statistically relevant features from the extracted feature set using Kruskal-Wallis method and train different machine learning classifiers with selected features. The beats are identified using the proposed algorithm and the results are compared with state-of-the-art methodologies via simulations. In this work, we have used a publicly available dataset from PhysioNet database.

articleTitle: Performance-based Comparative Analysis of Open Source Vulnerability Testing Tools for Web Database Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the last two decades, with the increase of information communications technology, the cybersecurity threats to web-based data-bases have seen exponential growth. Though the web database resources are tested for possible cyber threat vulnerabilities, it is challenging to identify the security weak points and back-doors of web database and applications to achieve data confidentiality and integrity. The vulnerability testing tools are used to find specific vulnerabilities on software or applications. This paper studies, analyses and compares the open-source vulnerability testing tools, SQLMAP and JSQL, for web database applications. A set of dummy URLs are introduced to evaluate the penetrating ability of both tools, and an analysis is presented to aid the users to choose a suitable tool based on security requirements.

articleTitle: Mitigating Man-in-the-Middle Attack in Digital Signature
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We all are living in the digital era, where the maximum of the information is available online. The digital world has made the transfer of information easy and provides the basic needs of security like authentication, integrity, nonrepudiation, etc. But, with the improvement in security, cyber-attacks have also increased. Security researchers have provided many techniques to prevent these cyber-attacks; one is a Digital Signature (DS). The digital signature uses cryptographic key pairs (public and private) to provide the message's integrity and verify the sender's identity. The private key used in the digital signature is confidential; if attackers find it by using various techniques, then this can result in an attack. This paper presents a brief introduction about the digital signature and how it is vulnerable to a man-in-the-middle attack. Further, it discusses a technique to prevent this attack in the digital signature.

articleTitle: A modified Miniaturized UWB Bi-Planar Yagi-Like MIMO Antenna System
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A novel 2-component ultra-wideband (UWB) Yagi antenna apparatus based multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) antenna framework is introduced. A loop excitation is done by setting the half roundabout circle component on each side of the receiving antenna substrate which lessens the general size by 45% and builds the data transfer capacity. The activity recurrence of the receiving antenna is picked 8.2 GHz for focusing on WLAN applications, having a transfer speed in the scope of 6 GHz to 8.2 GHz. The proposed antenna component has a size of 50×80×0.76 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Yagi antenna has great attributes with high directional radiation, the FBR front-to-back proportion of 18db, least increase of 5.35 dBi, and directivity of 6.7 dB, isolation of 17 dB, most extreme envelope co-relation coefficient (ECC) estimation of 0.082 and the total efficiency of above 94.19% over the band of activity.

articleTitle: RBS: A New Comparative and Better Solution of Sorting Algorithm for Array
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In modern technology or practical application, all things are gradually arranged. Therefore, in this paper, we attempt to establish a new sorting algorithm and compare it with some other standard sorting algorithms by their execution times. We designed and developed a methodology that can be executed on random data, ordering data, and some specific data (data means integers value), which can provide the best result for Right Bounding Sort (RBS). The methodology is comparing the array's left value with the rightmost value. Under a particular condition, these two values are swapped, then left index increase, and after completing the first step, the right index decrease, and it continues up to array size. Though there are many sorting algorithms invented for sorting an array with specific time complexity, space complexity, and other factors, they have some limitations because there is no sorting that is perfect for all various types of data. Some are good for small ranges of value, some are vast ranges of data, some are stable, and some are unstable. This algorithm performs with Big-O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) time complexity and Big-O (1) space complexity. We see that our new sorting algorithms provide better solutions than some other existing sorting algorithms like the bubble sort, insertion sort, cycle sort, etc. On the experimental dataset in respect of time complexity.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Multiband Multimode SIW antenna: Multi-band and multi mode SIW Antenna
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A multiband multimode circularly polarized Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) cavity-backed antenna is proposed in this paper. The antenna consists of a SIW cavity, two annular slots on top surface acts as a radiator. Two patch like radiation patterns and two monopole like radiation patterns at four different frequencies are excited by single probe feed antenna. In addition, antenna is frequency tunable and can be adjusted by varying length of slots. The simulated results show that the antenna radiates at 3.16, 6.35, 8.49, 9.85GHz frequencies. The proposed antenna capability is better than other antennas as it resonates at four different frequencies. The antenna has simple structure and high gain compared to other antennas.

articleTitle: Financial Investment Recommendation and Decentralized Account Management
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Know Your Customer (KYC) is performed by banks and financial institutions for customer verification. The process of KYC is tedious, redundant and time consuming since banks have to repeat this procedure for the same set of customers leading to heavy costs. A customer also has to undergo the same process multiple times. Further challenge faced by the customers is the time and fee related to interbank transactions. Not only this, but the hassle of managing all the different bank accounts is tiring and cumbersome. For an average customer, as if these challenges were not enough, comes the added issue of approaching a costly financial planner for investment recommendation. These escalating expenses demand a system which provides a way to complete the one-time KYC process along with investment recommendation and account management using a single interface. In this paper, we leverage properties of blockchain such as its tamper proof nature and non-repudiation for developing a decentralized network that ensures one-time KYC along with ease in inter-bank transactions. Further, the long-term retention capability of the RNN-LSTM model is used to analyze the time series data and predict the most suitable option for investment after calculating the risk-taking capacity of the user.

articleTitle: Continuous Pulse Rate Monitoring from Facial Video Using rPPG
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cardiovascular activity causes some imperceptible changes in different regions of human body. These changes set the stage for isolated systolic hypertension, diastolic dysfunction and heart failure, atrioventricular conduction defects and aorta valve calcification. Activity of heart, which is an indicator of physical health and lifestyle are required to be measured remotely and continuously. In this paper a system is proposed, which is able to estimate pulse rate of a subject remotely without any biological effects on it. Estimation is done by utilizing facial video of a subject. Our proposed framework utilize SLIC superpixels for ROI detection and adaptive least mean square method is adapted to suppress the effect of illumination variation. For performance verification we have tested our system on publicly available large database MAHNOB-HCI and shows that our method shows significant improvement than existing works.

articleTitle: Automated Detection and Segmentation of Laser Marks in Retinal Fundus Images of Preterm Infants
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Retinopathy of Prematurity (ROP) is a sight-threatening disorder that affects the retina of preterm infants. Laser photo-coagulation is an established treatment for severe ROP to suppress the growth of abnormal blood vessels. This leaves scars or laser marks on the retina's surface, and these laser marks can be detected falsely as blood vessels during followup visits. Therefore, this paper proposes efficient methods for detection, segmentation and removal of laser marks, as a preprocessing step to vessel segmentation. Removal of laser marks from the image will improve the visualization and segmentation of blood vessels and hence will be useful in disease prognosis. Relevant features that perfectly characterize the structure, intensity and texture of the laser marks are identified by training a K Nearest Neighbor classifier. The optimal feature set gave a detection accuracy of 98% and a sensitivity of 100% when tested on a real dataset of infant fundus images.

articleTitle: Retinal Lesions Detection for Screening of Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is an eye disease, which causes blindness in diabetic patients. Early detection and periodic screening of diabetic retinopathy can reduce the progress of the disease and reduce vision loss. Due to diabetic retinopathy, there are lesions in the retina. Retinal lesions are mainly dark and bright lesions. Lesions have different properties such as colour, shape, and size. Microaneurysms (MAs) and hemorrhages (HEMs) are dark lesions and exudates(EXs) are bright lesions. This work proposes a retinal lesions detection system for screening diabetic retinopathy. Top hat and bottom hat transform are used for the enhancement of the image for the dark lesion detection. The optic disc is suppressed first to facilitate further processing of bright lesion detection. Morphological opening and closing are used for the detection of the bright lesion. Two SVMs are used in this work, one SVM is used to classify the dark lesion into microaneurysms and hemorrhages, and other one classify the bright lesion into hard exudates and non-hard exudates.

articleTitle: A Smart Ambulatory Cognitive State Taxonomy System Through EEG Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Human mental state classification using Electroen-cephalogram(EEG) signal is one of the dynamic investigating areas in developing intelligent machine frameworks. In this paper, we propose an ambulatory cognitive state classification system using statistical feature analysis. The aim is to develop a realtime system which captures human cognitive states through computer-mediated help based on physiological signals. The walking cognitive state estimator is developed using a realtime Augmented Cognition (AugCog) framework. Six different normality testing methods i.e. Kolmogorov-Smirnov, Anderson Darling, Cramer-Von Mises, Shapiro Wilk, Jarque-Bera, D'Ago-stino and Pearson's test are applied to achieve better accuracy. Box - Cox - transformation is also applied to ensure whether the data follows a normal distribution. We apply Fisher Discriminant Ratio (FDR) for selecting the most discriminative feature amongst all the statistical features (i.e. Mean, Median, Mode, Standard Deviation, Variance, Skewness and Kurtosis) obtained from the signal. Various machine learning methods are applied on the extracted features for training, testing and validation. Probabilistic neural network (P-NN) with Kurtosis feature is found to produces a maximum accuracy of 92.61 % as compared to other classifiers.

articleTitle: Mitigation Technique for Black hole Attack in Mobile Ad hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Mobile Ad hoc Network is a very important key technology for device to device communication without any support of extra infrastructure. As it is being used as a mode of communication in various fields, protecting the network from various attacks becomes more important. In this research paper, we have created a real network scenario using random mobility of nodes and implemented Black hole Attack and Gray hole Attack, which degrades the performance of the network. In our research, we have found a novel mitigation technique which is efficient to mitigate both the attack from the network.

articleTitle: Video Game DRM: Analysis and Paradigm Solution
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Video game piracy is the illegal downloading and sharing of video game content, a type of copyright infringement. It is a major problem faced by video game publishers when selling their games, owing to the ease of downloading games through torrents or DDL websites. Digital Rights Management (DRM) tools are used to hinder piracy. And yet DRM remains a false barrier as crackers invariably break the DRM and release the video game on P2P file sharing platforms and torrent websites within few days of the launch of the video game. This research paper investigates the existing DRM or copy protection methods used in video games and presents new solutions that could be implemented with DRM thereby making the video games harder to crack.

articleTitle: A Switching Capacitor Based Buck-Boost Converter and its Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper deals with a buck-boost converter which depends upon a switching capacitor. A switching capacitor is used instead of a switching inductor because switching inductor provides higher efficiency over a large range of voltage values but it faces few problems practically limiting its performance. Numerous ways of boosting up the voltage is presented among which independent buck or boost along with buck boost conversion is discussed. A salient property of this is that there is a very small amount of current ripple irrespective of its working mode. Pulse width modulation (PWM) is used because this signal is produced to control power switches. The gain equations are obtained which defines the inductor and capacitor values to be used. The dc signal analysis is done. A decent power rated, 200kHz model with 100-V input DC source is used. It's experimental working along with its principles are shown.

articleTitle: Multi-trace Inversion with Selective Wedge to Increase Thin Layer Resolution in Horizontal Layer
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Hydrocarbon exploration largely depends on the identification of hydrocarbon patches trapped in a thin porous layer trapped between two solid layers. Seismic trace from data in inverted to produce reflective patterns that correlate with the physical rock layer properties of the strata. In the paper, multi-trace inversion done to maintain lateral continuity is combined with a wedge dictionary to identify a thin horizontal layer.

articleTitle: Logical Unit Design using Reversible HSG1 Gate and Its Application in ALU Design
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Due to reduced size and increase in component density, controlling heat dissipation is becoming a big challenge for chip designers and manufacturers and thus researchers, scientists, and engineers throughout the world are looking for newer technologies for remedy. One such technology that is providing a solution to the above-stated problem is Reversible Logic Technology (RL T). RLT is a new paradigm and finding its application in Quantum Computing, Nano-Electronics, Cryptography, Low-Power Low-Dissipation circuit designs. In this paper based on RLT, 16×16 Harsh Shiva Gate 1 (HSG1) is proposed. HSG1 gate can be programmed for performing 16, 1024, and 16384 logical output operations using 4, 10, and 14 programmable input pins respectively on two operand A and B in a single clock cycle. HSG1 gate has 2 Output Modes - Simultaneous and Cascade Mode. In Simultaneous Mode, a total of 14 programmable and 2 operand input pins are available for performing 65536 logical output operations at the output pins from x0 to x15. While in Cascade Mode, based on 4 selection input pins, X, Y, N, and P, 16 logical output operations are performed at the output pin L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OUT</inf>. The main advantage of cascade mode is using L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OUT</inf> as the input to the control unit of ALU when HSG 1 gate is used as a logical unit in designing of ALU. It has been also proved that the proposed HSG1 gate is better than its counterpart for implementing logical unit in terms of garbage output, the number of gates, and logical operations to be performed. All the results have been verified using VHDL simulation.

articleTitle: Real-Time Detection of Cyber Attacks on the IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cyber attacks are used to exploit vulnerabilities present in various connected critical systems and the Internet of Things(IoT) is no exception to this. The state of art presents many approaches to detect and mitigate such cyber attacks. Realtime deployment of such methods faces many challenges including a selection of development tools and platforms, limits on computing capabilities of IoT devices, high velocities of data pushed to cloud and heterogeneity of devices. This paper presents an experimental setup for the real-time deployment of security analytics for IoT devices using Google cloud platform. This paper also presents a summary of alternate tools available for real-time deployment of IoT security analytics including Amazon web services, Microsoft Azure and Open source tools.

articleTitle: Security Visualization and Active Querying for OT Network
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traditionally Industrial Control System(ICS) used air-gap mechanism to protect Operational Technology (OT) networks from cyber-attacks. As internet is evolving and so are business models, customer supplier relationships and their needs are changing. Hence lot of ICS are now connected to internet by providing levels of defense strategies in between OT network and business network to overcome the traditional mechanism of air-gap. This upgrade made OT networks available and accessible through internet. OT networks involve number of physical objects and computer networks. Physical damages to system have become rare but the number of cyber-attacks occurring are evidently increasing. To tackle cyber-attacks, we have a number of measures in place like Firewalls, Intrusion Detection System (IDS) and Intrusion Prevention System (IPS). To ensure no attack on or suspicious behavior within network takes place, we can use visual aids like creating dashboards which are able to flag any such activity and create visual alert about same. This paper describes creation of parser object to convert Common Event Format(CEF) to Comma Separated Values(CSV) format and dashboard to extract maximum amount of data and analyze network behavior. And working of active querying by leveraging packet level data from network to analyze network inclusion in real-time. The mentioned methodology is verified on data collected from Waste Water Treatment Plant and results are presented.

articleTitle: Multiagent approach for resource management in Smart Environments
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The dynamic nature of Smart Environments, enabled thanks to the Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm, requires the application of innovative resource discovery/selection services. Recommender systems provide useful and customized information, properly selected and filtered, for users and services. This paper proposes a multiagent approach for building a recommendation system in smart environments. Smart objects, enhanced IoT objects interacting among them and with users, are mapped through real-valued vectors obtained by word embedding techniques. The vectors are assigned to bio-inspired agents that, working autonomously, bring out a set of similarity grouped entities - clusters of smart objects with similar features - thus enabling an efficient and dynamic recommendation/selection system. Experiment results on synthetic and real datasets prove the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Designing of Cost-Effective Human Assistive Robot and Performance Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper represents an assistive robotic technology to assist elderly people who are unable to move frequently and walk properly and also forget to take medicine. The goal is to implement a prototype and test its capability for helping the elder people to make their life easy and live better. The working prototype has been designed for four features. First, it has a heartbeat sensor where doctors or nurses will easily measure the patient's heartbeat rate. The second one is a common box that will open by touch using an obstacle detector which is known as the sonar sensor. Third, an individual patient has an individual box that will open only by punch RFID. And lastly, the moving part of this robot where wheels are used including motors and sensors. This sensor flows the line and reaches the patient in proper time. This proposed robot is a design based on Arduino Uno and Arduino Nano. The proposed human assistive robot provides 96% to 99% accuracy to determine heart rate compared to ECG heart rate for smokers and nonsmoker persons in two different seasons-winter and summer. The prototype is developed to help the elderly people to make their life easy and reduce the nurse's work and make the digital hospital.

articleTitle: Implementation of Ship Motion Mobility Model in UnetStack for Underwater Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Unlike terrestrial networks, deployed sensor nodes in underwater networks can move due to ship movement, water current, etc. This movement of nodes in underwater networks causes a severe effect in the routing of data to the offshore destinations. Hence, nodes movement is one of the essential factors in designing a context-aware routing for underwater networks. This paper proposes a mathematical model to study the node movement in underwater networks due to the ship movements. Additionally, the proposed model is demonstrated through its implementation in UnetStack3.

articleTitle: Investigation of Reduced Size Annular Ring Patch Antenna with EBG Structure for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper represents relative analysis of performance parameters and cost comparison of different microstrip patch antennas. Rectangular and annular ring patch antennas have been designed considering the resonant frequency of 5.25 GHz. This frequency has been selected as so the proposed annular ring microstrip patch antenna can cover a well portion of few wireless applications like IEEE 802.11a Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) (5.125-5.395 GHz) Worldwide interoperability for Microwave Access (Wi-MAX) (5.25-5.85 GHz). The ground plane has been incorporated by fan shaped Electro-Magnetic Band Gap (EBG) to have better radiation patterns. The proposed annular ring patch antenna exhibits bandwidth of 202 MHz, directivity of 7.23 dBi and relatively healthy radiation efficiency of 88.39%. The noteworthy point of this particular design is its comparatively small size of the patch as well as ground plane. The design and simulation have been accomplished using FDTD method based transient solver of CST MWS software.

articleTitle: Detection of lung agents through rectangular hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2020 11th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Hydrochloric Acid (HCL) and Methyl Bromide (MBX) are two lung agents which have a very harmful effect on the human nose, eyes, lung, etc. In this research, we present a rectangular core photonic crystal fiber (RCPCF) sensor to detect these lung agents in the terahertz (THz) regime and Zeonex is selected as a fiber material for its fascinating properties.
